description: A high-resolution aerial or satellite photograph, circularly framed, depicts a dense forest situated within a mountainous or rugged terrain. The foreground and immediate slopes consist of barren or sparsely vegetated brown and tan rock and soil, suggesting steep cliffs or rocky outcrops. A deep valley or gorge is prominently featured, with its floor and distant slopes covered by a uniform, dense canopy of green, coniferous-looking trees. The image visually represents "Woodland and forest" land cover, consistent with land cover classification standards that define forest as areas with tree cover greater than 10% and a Minimum Mapping Unit (MMU) of 0.5 ha, where trees can reach 5 m height at maturity.
